name: mangadex-safe
description: Self-hosted, read-only, safe-mode MangaDex frontend for OpenWrt

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:static
scripts.size: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib');let t=0;for(const f of ['bundle.js','styles.css','index.html']){const g=z.gzipSync(fs.readFileSync('dist/'+f),{level:9}).length;t+=g;console.log(f.padEnd(11),(g/1024).toFixed(1),'KB gzipped')}console.log('total'.padEnd(11),(t/1024).toFixed(1),'KB gzipped (target: under 30)')"
